description: Reactive "Shakhed" hit the locomotive of the passenger train Zhytomyr - Odesa As reported by the head of "Ukrzaliznytsia" Alexander Pertsovsky, the train was stopped in advance, and the passengers were evacuated after a warning from the monitoring team. There were 593 passengers on board, including 15 children. No one was hurt. Onward travel to Odessa is organized for passengers.
description_en: Reactive "Shakhed" hit the locomotive of the passenger train Zhytomyr - Odesa As reported by the head of "Ukrzaliznytsia" Alexander Pertsovsky, the train was stopped in advance, and the passengers were evacuated after a warning from the monitoring team. На борту находились 593 пассажира, среди них 15 детей. Никто не пострадал. Для пассажиров организовывают дальнейший проезд до Одессы.
